elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to each party.
elements.evidence: The added language caps “each Party's aggregate liability” at the same amount.

elements.element: The cap includes fees paid or payable in the 12 months immediately preceding the claim.
elements.evidence: The cap is based on “amounts paid or payable by Sanofi under this Agreement” during the twelve months immediately preceding the claim. This supplies the required 12-month payment benchmark, although “fees” would be more precise.

elements.element: The cap has a USD 1,000,000 minimum, making it the greater of the 12-month fee benchmark and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: No USD 1,000,000 floor or greater-of formulation is included.

elements.element: Indirect damages are excluded mutually.
elements.evidence: The clause provides that “NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER” for indirect damages.

elements.element: Consequential damages are excluded mutually.
elements.evidence: The clause provides that “NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER” for consequential damages.

elements.element: Liability for breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Nothing in Section 14.5 limits damages available for breach of confidentiality obligations under Article XI, and the new cap is expressly subject to that carve-out.

elements.element: Liability for breach of data protection obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: There is no express carve-out for data protection obligations, and their inclusion within the confidentiality carve-out cannot be established from the language provided.

elements.element: Liability for breach of security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: There is no express carve-out for security obligations.

elements.element: Indemnification obligations are uncapped.
elements.evidence: The clause states that nothing in Section 14.5 limits or restricts indemnification rights or obligations under Sections 14.1 or 14.2, and the new cap is subject to that language.

elements.element: Liability arising from gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: The aggregate cap expressly does not apply “in the case of a Party's gross negligence.”

elements.element: Liability arising from wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: The aggregate cap expressly does not apply “in the case of a Party's ... willful misconduct.”

elements.element: Liability arising from fraud is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Fraud is not identified as an exception to the cap.

elements.element: Liability for infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: The clause protects damages for breach of obligations relating to intellectual property under Article X, but it does not expressly cover every infringement of the other party's IP; Article X's contents are not provided to establish equivalence.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are expressly excluded from the definition or treatment of damages for cap purposes.
elements.evidence: The clause does not state that Sanofi's or the Customer's payment obligations are not damages or otherwise outside the cap.

elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to each party.
elements.evidence: The added language caps “each Party's aggregate liability” at the same amount.

elements.element: The mutual cap is based on 12 months' fees.
elements.evidence: The cap is based on amounts paid or payable by Sanofi under the Agreement during the twelve months immediately preceding the claim, functioning as the required 12-month fee/payment benchmark.

elements.element: Indemnification obligations are uncapped.
elements.evidence: Indemnification rights and obligations under Sections 14.1 and 14.2 are expressly excluded from all limitations in Section 14.5.

elements.element: Liability for breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Damages for breach of confidentiality obligations under Article XI are expressly excluded from all limitations in Section 14.5.

elements.element: Liability arising from gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Gross negligence is expressly excepted from the aggregate cap.

elements.element: Liability arising from wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Willful misconduct is expressly excepted from the aggregate cap.

result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback: it adds a mutual 12-month payment-based cap and preserves or adds uncapped treatment for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, and willful misconduct. It does not reach the preferred position because it omits the USD 1,000,000 floor, data protection, security, fraud, a sufficiently explicit infringement carve-out, and protection for Customer payment obligations. The changes are limited to what is needed for the fallback and do not contradict the existing damages exclusions or carve-outs. Drafting quality is reduced because the cap refers broadly to “amounts paid or payable” rather than expressly to fees, and the IP carve-out does not clearly identify infringement of the other party's IP.
